sentences.text: I hate deep cleaning the house.
I swear no matter how much I declutter, there's always more junk.
Where does all this stuff even come from?
But if I don't use it, it's gotta go.
Can you take out the trash while I mop?
But only if I get to skip cleaning the bathroom.
Lucky for you, I already did it.
Want me to throw in a load of laundry?
Oh, and don't forget to fold them after they dry.
That's the best part, because I can watch our show while I do it.
You better not watch without me.
